# Plugins

Everything dash shows comes from a plugin. A plugin turns itself on when its settings are complete (rustfs is off unless `enabled: true`), and `plugins.<id>.enabled: false` turns it off; its pages are hidden while it does not run. Each page below is generated from the plugin's manifest, its settings schema and its hand-written notes (`cmd/dash/plugindocs/<id>.md`).

| Plugin | What | Pages | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Prometheus-compatible](prometheus.md) (`prometheus`) | VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus: the series behind charts, KPIs and host metrics. | - | - |
| [Alertmanager](alertmanager.md) (`alertmanager`) | Alerts and silences. | Alerts and silences | `silence.create`, `silence.expire` |
| [Gatus](gatus.md) (`gatus`) | Endpoint health. | Service status | - |
| [VictoriaLogs](victorialogs.md) (`victorialogs`) | The pod logs the UI shows. | - | - |
| [Proxmox VE](proxmox.md) (`proxmox`) | Virtual machines, containers and the hypervisor. | Virtual machines | - |
| [Hardware](hardware.md) (`hardware`) | The physical hosts behind the cluster. | Hardware | - |
| [Kubernetes](kubernetes.md) (`kubernetes`) | How dash reaches and reads the cluster. | Kubernetes cluster | `restart` |
| [Flux](flux.md) (`flux`) | Flux sources, kustomizations and Helm releases. | GitOps (Flux) | `reconcile` |
| [CloudNativePG](cnpg.md) (`cnpg`) | CloudNativePG Postgres clusters and the age of their last backup. | - | - |
| [RustFS](rustfs.md) (`rustfs`) | Buckets and capacity of a RustFS object store. | - | - |
| [Grafana](grafana.md) (`grafana`) | Links to dashboards. | - | - |
| [Headlamp](headlamp.md) (`headlamp`) | Deep links into the Kubernetes UI. | - | - |
| [Launcher](launcher.md) (`launcher`) | Links to your infrastructure. | - | - |
